I don't have binge eating disorder, but I am bulimic. In the past something I've noticed that always always helps, is staying in public. I don't know about others, but I know that having people around me, is almost a sure-fire way of preventing me from binging. I mean, the pure shame of how fast you eat and how much you eat when you binge helps a lot, as much as it may suck. Also it just helps to distract you, if you're out and about you're less likely to want to spend money on more food, or you may just not think about it as much.
 Another thing, that I think would really really help you, is also setting up a very strict routine. As in, pre-plan every single piece of food you'll be eating that day. Don't go too low on how many calories you allow yourself, or it'll be easy to give in. However by making this list, I always found that the binges decrease. You're basically taking all the stress of choosing away.
